title.value: DATA SET CREATION AND EMPIRICAL ANALYSIS FOR DETECTING SIGNS OF DEPRESSION FROM SOCIAL MEDIA POSTINGS
title.justification: The paper focuses on creating a data set specifically for detecting depression through social media postings and analyzing its effectiveness with various models.
title.quote: Thus, in this research, we developed a gold standard data set that detects the levels of depression as 'not depressed', 'moderately depressed' and 'severely depressed' from the social media postings.

extractions.description: This paper presents a study focused on creating a data set that detects signs of depression using social media postings. The authors developed a benchmark data set and employed various models to detect different levels of depression – 'not depressed', 'moderately depressed', and 'severely depressed'. The study also discusses the empirical analysis of traditional learning algorithms applied to the data set and highlights improvements through data augmentation techniques.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper focuses on mental health, it does not specifically target climate or ecologically-related sustainable development goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Depression is a common mental illness that has to be detected and treated at an early stage to avoid serious consequences.

applications.value: Detecting depression levels using social media data
applications.justification: The main application of the research is to identify signs and levels of depression through a developed benchmark data set.
applications.quote: Thus, in this research, we developed a gold standard data set that detects the levels of depression as 'not depressed', 'moderately depressed' and 'severely depressed' from the social media postings.
